setting.description: Environment inferred from the user's description (or the most natural real-world setting for these objects) and how it sits on the layout geometry.

object.description: The real object from the description this participant is.

appearance.description: Silhouette, proportions, materials, characteristic colours and the recognisable details to draw; facing/rotation/size choice.

props.description: Static or state-driven props implied by the situation (supports, surfaces, sources, containers, apparatus parts) and where they go.

palette.description: Harmonious colours for environment and subjects in LIGHT and DARK themes.

description.description: One or two sentences in the user's language describing the illustrated scene.

code.description: Complete async function(PIXI, app, api) expression following the system CODE CONTRACT: kit.standardScene({bodies:false}), base.backdrop(layout => svg), base.attach(id, sprite, options) for every participant, update/resize/setData delegating to base. PixiJS v8 API, complete SVG documents with literal colours, no // comments, under 40000 characters.
